Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Redwood & Brighton Analytics

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today — appreciate the candid conversation about Brighton's search & recommendations pipeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align with your procurement/timeline: 

Recap
- Current stack: in-house embedding store + rules-based reranker.
- Pain: high latency on batch reranks, spikes during monthly reports, and inconsistent engagement results after product search updates.
- Success metric: 15-20% lift in query-to-action conversion and 40% reduction in tail latency for reranking jobs.
- Constraints: security review + SOC-2 evidence required, procurement prefers 3-6 month pilot before a committed contract.

Suggested next steps
1) Pilot scope: 6-week pilot focused on rerank latency & quality (1 LLM-backed reranker + caching + KPIs).
2) Resources: Redwood AE + Solutions Engineer (cc'd Ava) + point of contact on your side (suggested: Alex / Data Eng).
3) Timeline: target pilot start mid-March if procurement clears.
4) Procurement ask: examples of SOC-2 evidence and draft SOW — attached.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (1-page recap), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed milestones + owners)

Can you confirm: 1) this captures what we discussed; 2) priority/timing on your side for a mid-March start; and 3) who on your team should review the MAP?

If it helps, Ava and I can do a 15-min procurement prep call next week to walk through the SOC-2 materials.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
